    Legend & methodology

    Orange = investor, fund or syndicator ownership found in records or trade press; review before treating as independent. Gold = independent or single-site (ownership not individually verified). Navy = regional private multi-site operator (verified from company sources; flagged so you can judge fit). Grey (off by default) = REIT, national brand, PE/institutional platform, or marketplace listing — removed from the target set.

    Owner of record: county appraisal data via TxGIO StratMap parcels (tax year 2026). Operating entity: Texas Comptroller sales-tax permits. NRSF: published figure where found; otherwise an estimate from Microsoft building footprints (Feb 2026) on the matched parcel. On 58 sites with a published figure, about 4 in 10 estimates fell within ±25%, and estimates tend to run low (median about 83% of published). Use them for screening only.

    Data: place listings and OpenStreetMap, collected Oct 13, 2026. Brand ownership verified from company sites and trade press; see the companion spreadsheet. Treat as a sourcing screen, not title evidence.
